fuente.titulo: Pope: May we pray for the intercession of the Virgin Mary for world peace

titular: Pope Leo announces synod on family life
bajada: Ten years after Amoris Laetitia, Vatican to host discernment on the family
caption: After the Angelus, Pope Leo XIV invited the faithful to continue praying the Rosary for peace, joining Aid to the Church in Need's initiative, with special intention for the Holy Land and victims of violence. He also expressed joy over tributes to Saint Francis of Assisi and announced a new period of synodal discernment on the family, to take place at the Vatican ten years after Pope Francis's apostolic exhortation Amoris Laetitia. Source: Vatican News, Oct 4, 2026.
